zh-CN: 修复仅框选、未说话时，语音识别的无语音结果阻止翻译、总结与解释的问题。
界面语言与本机语音识别语言独立；切换界面语言不再中止正在进行的语音操作。
语言选择中的“简体中文”始终保留中文名称。
en: Fix silent selections being blocked by a no-speech recognition result when translating, summarizing or explaining.
Keep the interface language independent from local speech recognition; changing the interface language no longer cancels an active recording.
Keep the Simplified Chinese option labeled in Chinese in language menus.
